utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive is getting organized, so I’m going to stop by and see what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, that sounds sensible. I’ll keep my eye out for anything else they still need.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s the plan. I’ll check in and let you know if they’re short on anything specific.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, what's the repair drive for?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It’s for fixing the shared stuff we’ve been putting off. I’m trying to get the drive organized so we can tackle the repairs together.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, so just the shared repairs. What’s first on the list?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So this repair drive is actually happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think so, but I want to know who’s covering the schedule and where the parts are coming from first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, but I’m not counting it as real until someone confirms the schedule and parts.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive. I think I was supposed to bring something over, but I’ve misplaced the note. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Could you bring the box of screws and the small cordless drill? That’s the part I’m short on.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing, I’ll grab the box of screws and the small cordless drill right now.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Can you remind me what’s included in the repair drive? I want to check the details before I help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: It’s mostly the usual stuff: tools, a few spare parts, and whatever needs patching up. I might be missing one item, but that’s the gist.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you list the missing item, or should I just check the rest of the load against what you’ve got?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late - what did I miss on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: You’re just in time — we’ve got the list sorted and are pairing people up for the last few repairs.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, I’m here now - who’s left on the list?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Gus — I can help with the repair drive. Just tell me what needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Gus. Point me to the first thing that needs fixing and I’ll get started.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’d check the repair drive location and make sure we have the right address before anyone heads out.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’d like to confirm the address first so nobody ends up at the wrong place.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive's picking up this week, and folks are dropping off tools by the community hall. If you need anything fixed, now's the time to put your name in.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll spread the word and see if anyone needs help hauling things over. If you hear of a spot with extra space, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll ask around for a place with extra room and let you know if I hear of one.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time does the repair drive start?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It starts at 9 a.m.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll tell them we’re on it and keep the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it. I’ll keep an ear out and follow whatever updates you send.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I will. I’ll keep everyone posted as the repair drive moves along.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, I’ll coordinate the repair drive and keep everyone posted.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I appreciate you handling it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive is moving along nicely — I heard they’re collecting supplies all afternoon. Eli, if you’ve got spare tools or a free hand, now’s a good time to swing by.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Heard that, Eli — I’m heading over after lunch with a couple of spare tools and some time to help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — what still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Mostly just the cleanup and sorting now. I’ve got the list with me, and I’ll repeat it out so we can split it up.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, read it out and I’ll take the cleanup end.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that, but I need a little more detail on what the repair drive is fixing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It’s for my bicycle. The rear wheel keeps slipping, and I need it checked.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks for the detail. I can help check the rear wheel slipping on your bicycle.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I need a hand hauling the repair drive supplies over to the church basement. Can you meet me there this afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can make it this afternoon. What time should I meet you there?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Hana, I can help round up a few more people for the repair drive if you want.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That would be great, Jules. Can you check with a few people and let me know who’s in?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, I’ll check with a few people and let you know who’s in.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I can help with that—what’s changed on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I just need a couple of hands-on fixes, mainly sorting the parts and checking the schedule. Can you still come by this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I should still be able to make it this weekend. Just point me to the parts pile and the schedule, and I’ll help sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard they’re getting the repair drive together. Need me to pass anything along?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, I can tell folks to bring any broken bits and hand tools they’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with that, Leo. Tell me what needs fixing and I’ll see what I can do.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure. Send me the list and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Leo. I’ll send over the list shortly.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a little worried about the timing and who’s handling the transport. If we can confirm the schedule first, I’ll feel better about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Who’s confirmed for transport, and what time are we locking in?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I haven’t heard the transport confirmed yet, so I’d rather lock that down before we set a time.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m spreading the word already, Cleo. Come by the repair drive and bring anyone else who wants to help.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll bring extra tape and gloves, and I can ask Marisol to stop by too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, thank you. I’ll tell the others to bring tools and meet us there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with that after I get the school pickup sorted. What time are you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: How about around 4? I can be there after lunch and keep it short so it doesn't run too late.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 4 works for me after pickup. I’ll meet you then and keep it quick.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Nell. I’ll keep the repair drive moving and make sure everyone knows where to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ll spread the word too, since I’m mostly hearing things second-hand. Just tell me where you need me.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, thanks, Nell. I’ll send you a short list tonight, and you can take the corner nearest your place if that works.
